summary: Dashboard/App mit DNA-Helix-Design; Start eines datenorientierten Dashboard-Bereichs für Intervallfasten.
architectural_notes: Dashboard nutzt DNA-Helix als zentrales UI-Element; Intervallfasten wird als datenorientierter Modulbereich integriert.

existing_features.title: Add a data-oriented Intermittent Fasting detail view that appears on the dashboard when the “Intermittent Fasting” factor is selected, emphasizing quantitative metrics and structured data (KPIs, timelines, and summaries) rather than a minimal/abstract presentation.

Implement the Intermittent Fasting panel contents to include: (1) a current status block (Fasting / Eating Window / Starts In…), (2) a timer-style time readout for time remaining or time elapsed, (3) a progress indicator for the current window, (4) a daily + weekly summary (e.g., fasting sessions count, total fasting hours), (5) a streak metric, and (6) a small “insights/tips” area based on the current phase; all user-facing strings must be in English (and German when DE is selected) using the existing i18n structure.

Ensure the fasting panel integrates cleanly into the existing StartDashboard layout with responsive behavior (mobile through desktop), without obscuring the helix visuals or breaking existing factor marker interactions.

new_feature_requests.summary: Datenorientierten Intervallfasten-Bereich im Dashboard gestalten (Timer/Status, Fortschritt, Tages-/Wochen-Übersicht, Streak/Statistiken, Hinweise).

projectName: Add a data-oriented Intermittent Fasting dashboard section
